resources.string: Install and open Ragent on your Windows, macOS, or Linux computer.
Your computer does not need to sign in first.
On your computer, open “Phone pairing”, then “Start phone pairing”.
Choose trusted pairing and create a code. Scan it to sign the computer in with your phone account.
Open Ragent on your computer, then scan its code with your phone.
Check your network and try again. Your computer list could not be confirmed.
Check that Ragent is open on your computer and both devices are online.
On your computer, open “Phone pairing” → “Start phone pairing”, choose temporary pairing and create a code.
After confirmation on the computer, you can manage projects, sessions and agent settings.
Access ends 10 minutes after the computer confirms. Neither device needs to sign in.
Could not open the scanner. Check that the camera is available and camera permission is allowed, then try again.
